meaning.en: The definition of verboten is German for forbidden.

sentences.en: Perhaps because a fully configured MediaBox could be regarded as an invitation to record copyright material which is strictly verboten even for personal use.

sentences.en: While it may seem sweets are verboten on a low carb diet, you might be surprised to learn several sweet snacks are "allowed."
